questions.question: Which two signa should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 12 – 6 ÷ 12 × 6 + 6 = 9
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signa should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

12 – 6 ÷ 12 × 6 + 6 = 9
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and ÷

12 - 6 + 12 × 6 ÷ 6 = 12 - 6 + 12 × 1

6 + 12 ≠ 9

Interchanging × and +

\(12 - 6 \div 12 + 6 \times 6 = 12 - \frac{6}{{12}} + 36\)

\(48 - \frac{1}{2} \ne 9\)

Interchanging – and +

\(12 + 6 \div 12 \times 6 - 6 = 12 + \frac{6}{{12}} \times 6 - 6\)

12 + 3 - 6 = 9

Interchanging ÷ and ×

12 - 6 × 12 ÷ 6 + 6 = 12 - 6 × 2 + 6

12 - 12 + 6 ≠ 9

Hence by interchanging – and + we get correct equation.

questions.question: Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. (12, 16, 28)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(12, 16, 28)
questions.solution:
2nd term = 1st term + \(\frac{{1st\;term\;}}{3}\)

3rd term = (1st term × 2) + \(\frac{{1st\;term\;}}{3}\)

(12, 16, 28) → 12 + \(\frac{{12}}{3}\) = 16 and 12 × 2 + 4 = 28

(20, 25, 35) → 20 + \(\frac{{20}}{3}\) ≠ 25

(9, 15, 21) → 9 + \(\frac{9}{3}\) ≠ 15

(18, 24, 42) → 18 + \(\frac{{18}}{3} = 24\) and 18 × 2 + \(\frac{{18}}{3} = 42\)

(36, 48, 77) → 36 + \(\frac{{36}}{3} = 48\) and 36 × 2 + \(\frac{{36}}{3}\) ≠ 77

Hence (18, 24, 42) is correct answer.

questions.questionHtml: Rs. 820 is divided among 6 men, 8 women, and 12 boys in such a way that every woman gets an amount equal to that received by one man and one boy combined and that every man gets one and a half times the amount received by a boy. What is the total amount received by 8 women?
questions.solution:
Let amount received by 1 boy = X

Then amount received by 1 man = 1.5 X

And amount received by 1 woman = 2.5 X

Total amount = (12 × X + 6 × 1.5X + 8 × 2.5X ) = (12X + 9X + 20X)

(12X + 9X + 20X) = 820

41X = 820

X = 20

Amount received by 1 woman = 20 × 2.5 = 50

Amount received by 8 women’s = 50 × 8 = 400.

Hence 400 is correct answer.

questions.question: If sin θ = 4 cos θ, then what is the value of sin θ cos θ?
questions.questionHtml: If sin θ = 4 cos θ, then what is the value of sin θ cos θ?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Given: sin θ = 4 cos θ ⇒ tan θ = 4/1

Consider a right-angled triangle where Perpendicular (P) = 4 and Base (B) = 1.

Hypotenuse (H) = √(42 + 12) = √17

sin θ cos θ = (P/H) × (B/H) = (4/√17) × (1/√17) = 4/17

∴ The correct answer is 4/17.

Alternate Method

Given: sin θ = 4 cos θ

Formula Used: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ; sin θ cos θ = tan θ / sec2θ; sec2θ = 1 + tan2θ

⇒ sin θ / cos θ = 4

⇒ tan θ = 4

⇒ sin θ cos θ = (sin θ / cos θ) × cos2θ

⇒ sin θ cos θ = tan θ × (1 / sec2θ)

⇒ sin θ cos θ = tan θ / (1 + tan2θ)

⇒ Substituting tan θ = 4: 4 / (1 + 42)

⇒ 4 / (1 + 16) = 4/17

∴ The correct answer is 4/17.

Additional Information

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identity: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1. Also, sec2θ − tan2θ = 1 and cosec2θ − cot2θ = 1.

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 8 : 9. After 9 years, this ratio will become 19 : 21. C is 3 years younger to B. What is the present (in years) of C?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 8 : 9. After 9 years, this ratio will become 19 : 21. C is 3 years younger to B. What is the present (in years) of C?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Make the age difference equal: (9 − 8) × 2 → 16 : 18 and (21 − 19) × 1 → 19 : 21.

Ratio increase: 19 − 16 = 3 units, which corresponds to 9 years.

1 unit = 3 years. Present age of B = 18 × 3 = 54 years.

Present age of C = 54 − 3 = 51 years.

∴ The correct answer is 51 years.

Alternate Method

Given: Ratio of present ages A:B = 8:9. Ratio after 9 years = 19:21. C = B − 3.

Let present ages of A and B be 8x and 9x respectively.

⇒ (8x + 9) ÷ (9x + 9) = 19 ÷ 21

⇒ 21(8x + 9) = 19(9x + 9)

⇒ 168x + 189 = 171x + 171

⇒ 3x = 18

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Present age of B = 9 × 6 = 54 years.

⇒ Present age of C = 54 − 3 = 51 years.

∴ The correct answer is 51 years.

Additional Information

Concept of Age Difference

The numerical difference between the ages of two persons remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the years passed.

Ratio Balancing Method

To solve age ratios quickly, multiply the ratios by the difference of the other ratio to make the parts corresponding to time equal.

Linear Equation in Ages

If the ratio is a:b, ages are ax and bx. After 'n' years, the new ratio is (ax + n)/(bx + n) = c/d.

questions.question: The distance between two station A and B is 800 km. A train X starts from A and moves towards B at 40 km/h and another trains Y starts from B and moves towards A at 60 km/h. how far from A will they cross each other?
questions.questionHtml: The distance between two station A and B is 800 km. A train X starts from A and moves towards B at 40 km/h and another trains Y starts from B and moves towards A at 60 km/h. how far from A will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Since both trains start at the same time, Distance is directly proportional to Speed (D ∝ S).

Ratio of speeds of Train X and Train Y = 40 : 60 = 2 : 3.

Total distance (800 km) is divided in the ratio 2 : 3.

Distance from Station A = [2 ÷ (2 + 3)] × 800 = (2/5) × 800 = 320 km.

∴ The correct answer is 320 km.

Alternate Method

Given:

Distance between Station A and B = 800 km

Speed of Train X = 40 km/h

Speed of Train Y = 60 km/h

Formula Used:

Relative Speed (Opposite direction) = S1 + S2

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Calculations:

⇒ Relative Speed = 40 + 60 = 100 km/h

⇒ Time taken to meet = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 800 ÷ 100 = 8 hours

⇒ Distance from Station A = Speed of Train X × Time

⇒ Distance = 40 × 8 = 320 km

∴ The correct answer is 320 km.

Additional Information

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum (S1 + S2). When they move in the same direction, it is the difference (S1 − S2).

Constant Time Rule

If two objects start at the same time and meet, the ratio of distances covered is equal to the ratio of their speeds: D1/D2 = S1/S2.

Average Speed

For the same distance covered at different speeds S1 and S2, Average Speed = (2 × S1 × S2) ÷ (S1 + S2).

questions.question: ABDC is a parallelogram in which diagonals AD and BC intersect at O. AE and DF are perpendicular on BC at E and F, respectively. Which of the following is not true?

The statement ΔADC ≅ ΔABD implies AC = AB, which is only true if the parallelogram is a rhombus.

Therefore, for a general parallelogram, the vertex correspondence in ΔADC ≅ ΔABD is incorrect.

∴ The correct answer is ΔADC ≅ ΔABD.

Key Points

  • The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.
  • The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.
  • The Passive voice in this question is in Present Continuous. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Present Continuous.
  • In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + being + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).
  • Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are + Verb (ing) + Object.
  • For example:
    • A document is being typed by Arnab. (Passive Voice)
    • Arnab is typing a document. (Active Voice)
  • The options except (2) don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Children are painting the wall of this park.

questions.solution:
Let us look at the meaning of the given sentence. We can see that the sentence wants to convey that the artist has continued painting the wall over a period of one week.

For example: I have been waiting for him since 5 o'clock.

(The action of waiting started at 5 o'clock and has been continuing till the present time).

The correct version of the sentence will be: The street artist Satish Munjal has been painting this wall for the past one week.

'For' is the preposition used to refer to the period it has taken since the starting point of an action till the present time.

Therefore, the part of the sentence in option 2 has the error.

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. A. In fact, Canada accounts for nearly one-third of the world's production of news print. B. Forest products, therefore, have been important export items of Canada for more than a century. C. A large part of Canada is covered with coniferous trees. D. Pulp and paper are their two most important forest products.
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

A. In fact, Canada accounts for nearly one-third of the world's production of news print.

B. Forest products, therefore, have been important export items of Canada for more than a century.

C. A large part of Canada is covered with coniferous trees.

D. Pulp and paper are their two most important forest products.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is CBDA

Key Points

  • The first sentence should stand independently in meaning and introduce the topic of the passage. Only sentence C fulfills this criteria. It introduces the main theme of the passage. Therefore, sentence C is the first sentence.
  • Sentence A cannot follow sentence C logically since it deals with a different topic altogether.
  • Out of the other two, it is clear that sentence B comes before sentence D since it introduces the topic of 'forest products' that is further expanded on in D.Therefore, sentence B is the second sentence and sentence D is the third sentence.
  • Finally, sentence A is the last sentence. It also logically follows sentence D because it mentions the 'production of news print' which obviously comes from the mention of 'pulp and paper' from sentence D.
  • Therefore, the correct order of sentences is CBDA.

​
Thus, the sentences when arranged will appear in the following manner: A large part of Canada is covered with coniferous trees. Forest products, therefore, have been important export items of Canada for more than a century. Pulp and paper are their two most important forest products. In fact, Canada accounts for nearly one-third of the world's production of news print.
